decisions.statement: A name is honoured only where the seat's own id begins the name.
A call the seat makes has nothing.
The name reaches a command through the environment of the call the command runs in.
A name with a character no id is written in is left off rather than spelled into a command.
A payload naming no subagent leaves the call as the call is.
This hook changes the command a call runs rather than judging that call.

definition: a naming of a subagent by its seat and its own id, carried into the calls it makes
